properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued November 20 at 10:04AM EST until November 20 at 12:30PM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
FFWMLB

The National Weather Service in Melbourne has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northeastern Volusia County in east central Florida...

* Until 1230 PM EST.

* At 1004 AM EST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 3 and 5 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 2 to 3 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Daytona Beach, Port Orange, Ormond Beach, South Daytona, Holly
Hill, Ormond-By-the-Sea, Daytona Beach Shores, Daytona
International Speedway, Daytona Beach Airport, Ponce Inlet, Ormond
Beach Airport, Allandale, Wilbur By The Sea, Spruce Creek, Harbor
Oaks and Samsula-Spruce Creek.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 12:30 PM EST. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 12:30 PM EST. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued November 20 at 12:23PM EST until November 20 at 2:30PM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:

* Flash Flood Warning for...

* Until 230 PM EST.

* At 1223 PM EST, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 3 and 5 inches of rain
